description: The desk a row sits on, set per source in config/sources.json and config/status.json and never inferred from a headline. The page groups its views by desk and the Explorer filters on it.

values.label: Security
values.definition: The security desk: advisories, research, press, KEV, CVEs, history rows and Patch Tuesday. Every source the Hub read before November 2026 sits here.

values.label: Infrastructure
values.definition: The infrastructure desk: vendor service health and cloud health incidents, and the internet, cloud-change, certificate and maintenance sources the revision plan adds.

values.label: IT lifecycle
values.definition: The IT lifecycle desk: end-of-life and release schedules, standards and benchmark updates, and IT press. Reserved for the sources the revision plan adds; no source carries it yet.
